name: Anthropic PBC
one_line: AI lab that makes the Claude models; buys compute from Google, Amazon, Microsoft, SpaceX/xAI, Nscale, Lambda, Volta and CoreWeave.
notes: Run-rate revenue above $30bn as of April 2026 per its own announcement.

name: OpenAI Group PBC
one_line: Maker of ChatGPT; the largest single buyer of AI compute in the world through Stargate, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, CoreWeave and Cerebras.

name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp.
one_line: Rocket and satellite company that absorbed xAI in 2026; owns the Colossus data centres and sells compute to Anthropic, Google and Reflection AI.
notes: Ticker as reported after the June 2026 IPO; verify before use.

name: xAI
one_line: Elon Musk's AI lab behind Grok, now part of SpaceX; builds its own GPU clusters in Memphis.
notes: Merged into SpaceX; deals from 2026 are recorded under spacex.

name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
one_line: Owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp; spends $130-145bn a year on AI infrastructure and buys chips from Nvidia, AMD and Google.

name: Microsoft Corporation
one_line: Cloud and software company; spends about $175bn a year on data centres and rents extra GPUs from Nebius, IREN, Nscale, Lambda and CoreWeave.

name: Alphabet Inc. / Google LLC
one_line: Search and cloud company that makes its own TPU chips; spends $195-205bn in 2026 and still rents GPUs from SpaceX/xAI.

name: Amazon.com, Inc.
one_line: Largest cloud provider; spends about $220bn in 2026, makes Trainium chips and hosts Anthropic and OpenAI.

name: Oracle Corporation
one_line: Database and cloud company building most of OpenAI's Stargate capacity; $638bn of contracted future business.

name: NVIDIA Corporation
one_line: Dominant maker of AI GPUs; also invests in and guarantees its customers' data-centre obligations.

name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
one_line: Chip maker whose Instinct GPUs are the main alternative to Nvidia; has 6GW deals with both OpenAI and Meta.

name: Broadcom Inc.
one_line: Designs custom AI chips including Google's TPUs; the channel through which Anthropic gets 3.5GW of TPUs.

name: Cerebras Systems Inc.
one_line: Maker of wafer-scale AI chips; sells 750MW of inference capacity to OpenAI.

name: CoreWeave, Inc.
one_line: GPU cloud provider renting capacity to Microsoft, OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Perplexity and, until 2026, Poolside.

name: Nebius Group N.V.
one_line: GPU cloud provider with large contracts from Microsoft, Meta and Reflection AI.

name: Nscale Global Holdings Ltd
one_line: British AI infrastructure builder supplying Microsoft, Anthropic, OpenAI (Norway, UK) and Singtel.

name: Group 42 Holding Ltd
one_line: Abu Dhabi AI holding company building Stargate UAE for OpenAI; licensed by the US to receive AI chips.

name: HUMAIN
one_line: Saudi Public Investment Fund company building 6.6GW of AI data centres, hosting xAI and Luma and buying Nvidia, AMD and Qualcomm chips.

name: Poolside AI
one_line: Coding-model start-up planning a 2GW Texas campus whose CoreWeave anchor deal collapsed in 2026.
notes: Also has a Paris presence; HQ per company filings should be verified.

name: Luma AI, Inc.
one_line: Video and world-model lab; raised $900m from HUMAIN and will train on HUMAIN's 2GW Project Halo.

name: Groq, Inc.
one_line: Inference cloud company; after licensing its chip technology to Nvidia it is buying capacity toward 200MW by end-2027.

name: Together Computer, Inc.
one_line: Inference and GPU cloud company that rents capacity from Hypertec, Rumble and IBM to resell.

name: Rumble Inc.
one_line: Video platform that now hosts Nvidia B300 GPUs and rents them to Together AI.

name: International Business Machines Corporation
one_line: Enterprise IT company selling Nvidia B300 cloud capacity to Together AI.

name: Snowflake Inc.
one_line: Cloud data platform that committed $6bn to AWS over five years for AI and Graviton compute.

name: Magic AI, Inc.
one_line: Coding-model lab with Google Cloud H100 and GB200 supercomputers.

name: Sakana AI
one_line: Tokyo AI lab making small Japanese-language models; its only disclosed compute is a 2024 GENIAC supercomputer grant.

name: Zhipu AI
one_line: Chinese large-model lab listed in Hong Kong in January 2026 to fund model R&D.
notes: Ticker as reported at listing; verify.

name: Reflection AI
one_line: Open-model lab buying more than $1bn of Nebius compute and renting from SpaceX/xAI.

name: Tesla, Inc.
one_line: Electric-car maker running over 205MW of AI training compute in Texas after cancelling its Dojo chip.

name: Eli Lilly and Company
one_line: Drug maker installing over 1,000 Nvidia B300 GPUs for drug discovery.

name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
one_line: Largest US bank; $19.8bn technology budget in 2026 with about $1.2bn for AI.

name: Mizuho Bank, Ltd.
one_line: Japanese bank building an on-premises Nvidia DGX B200 AI factory.
notes: Ticker is the parent Mizuho Financial Group.

name: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation
one_line: Singapore bank raising annual technology spend to close to S$1bn.

name: Malayan Banking Berhad
one_line: Malaysia's largest bank; RM10bn technology and AI plan to 2030.

name: Tata Consultancy Services Limited
one_line: India's largest IT services firm; its HyperVault unit is building over 1GW of AI data centres with TPG money and hosts OpenAI's first 100MW in India.

name: TPG Inc.
one_line: Private-equity firm investing $1bn in TCS HyperVault.

name: Reliance Industries Limited
one_line: India's largest conglomerate; pledged about $110bn over seven years for AI data centres at Jamnagar and Visakhapatnam.

name: Reliance Intelligence Limited
one_line: Reliance's AI subsidiary running 120MW of Nvidia GB300 at Jamnagar to serve 500 million Jio users.
notes: Jio Platforms Limited is the empanelled IndiaAI provider; the AI infrastructure sits under Reliance Intelligence.

name: Sarvam AI
one_line: Indian sovereign-model start-up that trained on 4,096 government-subsidised H100s at Yotta.

name: Yotta Data Services Private Limited
one_line: Indian GPU cloud and data-centre operator; hosts Sarvam's IndiaAI allocation.

name: IndiaAI Mission
one_line: MeitY's Rs 10,372 crore programme that rents subsidised GPUs to Indian developers; 38,000 GPUs onboarded, under Rs 401 crore released by February 2026.

name: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (India)
one_line: Indian ministry that funds and runs the IndiaAI Mission.

name: IndiaAI empanelled cloud service providers (collective)
one_line: The group of Indian cloud companies supplying GPUs to the IndiaAI portal.

name: Adani Group
one_line: Indian infrastructure conglomerate pledging $100bn of AI data centres by 2035 and building Google's Vizag hub.
notes: Ticker is Adani Enterprises, the group flagship.

name: HCL Technologies Limited
one_line: Indian IT services firm investing Rs 3,500 crore in a 50MW AI data-centre platform.

name: Larsen & Toubro Limited
one_line: Indian engineering group building 30MW of Nvidia GPU capacity in Chennai and 40MW in Mumbai.

name: Krutrim
one_line: Ola founder Bhavish Aggarwal's AI company, which pivoted from models and chips to GPU cloud services in 2026.

name: SoftBank Corp.
one_line: Japanese telecom operator (distinct from SoftBank Group) building the 140MW Sakai AI data centre and anchoring Noetra.
notes: Do not confuse with SoftBank Group Corp. (TYO:9984), the OpenAI investor.

name: NTT DATA Group Corporation
one_line: NTT's IT services and data-centre arm, reported to plan 1.5 trillion yen of Japanese data centres to 2033.

name: Noetra Corp.
one_line: Japanese consortium company (SoftBank Corp., Sony, NEC, Honda and about 44 others) building the METI-backed national AI factory with 27,500 Nvidia Rubin GPUs.

name: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (Japan)
one_line: Japanese ministry funding GENIAC, GPU cloud subsidies and the FRONTia national AI factory.

name: New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization
one_line: METI's funding agency that administers GENIAC compute grants.

name: RIKEN
one_line: Japan's national research institute, home of Fugaku and the new Blackwell-based RIKYU system.

name: Cabinet of Japan
one_line: Japan's national government, which approved the 10 trillion yen chip and AI support framework through FY2030.

name: Ministry of Science and ICT (Republic of Korea)
aliases: Korea Ministry of Science and ICT
one_line: Korean ministry that buys national GPUs and runs the sovereign foundation-model contest.

name: LG Group
one_line: Korean conglomerate whose LG AI Research is a finalist in the national AI model project and which is building a group AI factory with Nvidia.
notes: Ticker is LG Corp, the holding company.

name: SK Telecom Co., Ltd.
one_line: Korean mobile operator, finalist in the national AI model project and OpenAI's Korean data-centre partner.

name: Upstage
one_line: Korean model start-up (Solar models), finalist in the national AI foundation-model project.

name: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
one_line: Korean electronics and memory maker; Stargate memory supplier and 50,000-GPU AI factory builder.

name: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (Singapore)
one_line: Singapore ministry that owns the National AI Strategy and the S$1bn AI research commitment.

name: Singapore Telecommunications Limited
one_line: Singapore telecom group that sells GPU-as-a-service and swaps capacity with Nscale.

name: Advanced Info Service Public Company Limited
one_line: Thailand's largest mobile operator; spent 4bn baht on its own data centres for a sovereign cloud.

name: PLDT Inc.
one_line: Philippine telecom group whose VITRO Sta. Rosa is the country's first AI-ready hyperscale data centre.

name: CMC Corporation
one_line: Vietnamese IT group building a $250m, 30-120MW hyperscale data centre.

name: Kinh Bac City Development Holding Corporation
one_line: Vietnamese industrial-park developer proposing a $2bn, 200MW, 100,000-GPU data centre.

name: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
one_line: World's largest electronics manufacturer; building a 10,000-GPU Nvidia supercomputer for Taiwan's NSTC.

name: National Science and Technology Council (Taiwan)
one_line: Taiwan's science ministry, targeting 480 petaflops of national supercomputing by 2029.

name: National Center for High-performance Computing
one_line: Taiwan's national supercomputing centre, procuring the NSTC's petaflop targets.

name: Hong Kong Cyberport Management Company Limited
one_line: Hong Kong government-owned tech park operating the 3,000-petaflop AI Supercomputing Centre.

name: Digital Policy Office, Hong Kong SAR Government
one_line: Hong Kong government office funding the HK$3bn AI Subsidy Scheme.

name: Apple Inc.
one_line: Consumer-electronics company now running part of Apple Intelligence on Google Cloud.

name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited
one_line: Chinese e-commerce and cloud group with a RMB 380bn-plus three-year AI infrastructure budget.

name: Moonshot AI
one_line: Chinese lab behind the Kimi models, using about 20,000 Nvidia chips via Alibaba.

name: Lambda
one_line: GPU cloud provider serving Microsoft and Anthropic.

name: Volta
one_line: Nvidia cloud partner founded in 2026 that sold Anthropic a $10bn Norwegian data centre deal.
notes: HQ city and website not found.

name: Fluidstack Ltd
one_line: AI cloud builder that is Anthropic's main US data-centre partner, backstopped by Google.

name: TeraWulf Inc.
one_line: Former bitcoin miner leasing data-centre shell and power to Anthropic and Fluidstack.

name: Riot Platforms, Inc.
one_line: Former bitcoin miner leasing 191MW at Rockdale, Texas to Anthropic.

name: Hut 8 Corp.
one_line: Data-centre developer whose Beacon Point campus hosts Nvidia and Lambda capacity for Anthropic.

name: SB Energy
one_line: SoftBank-owned energy developer building OpenAI's 8GW Ohio campus.

name: Mistral AI
one_line: French lab that wants 1GW of European compute by 2030, partly funded by selling capacity commitments to enterprises.

name: Cohere Inc.
one_line: Canadian enterprise-model lab with a $220m sovereign GPU contract on Bell infrastructure.

name: BUZZ HPC
one_line: Canadian GPU cloud provider supplying Cohere on Bell AI Fabric.

name: Safe Superintelligence Inc.
one_line: Ilya Sutskever's lab, which rents Google TPUs and has disclosed nothing else about its compute.
notes: Also has a Tel Aviv office.

name: Thinking Machines Lab
one_line: Mira Murati's lab with a single-digit-billions Google Cloud GB300 contract.

name: Perplexity AI, Inc.
one_line: AI search company buying inference capacity from Microsoft, CoreWeave and AWS.

name: ElevenLabs
one_line: Voice-AI company using Google Cloud Nvidia Blackwell GPUs.

name: ByteDance Ltd.
one_line: Owner of TikTok and Douyin; private, with widely varying reports of 2026 AI chip spending.

name: Tencent Holdings Limited
one_line: Chinese internet group whose AI spending is limited by GPU access.

name: Baidu, Inc.
one_line: Chinese search company buying mostly its own Kunlun AI chips.

name: NAVER Corporation
one_line: Korean internet company taking over 60,000 Nvidia GPUs for sovereign AI.

name: Ministry of Science and ICT, Republic of Korea
one_line: Alias record: same body as msit-korea.
notes: DUPLICATE of msit-korea kept only because deals_demand.json uses this id; merge the two.

name: European Commission
one_line: EU executive offering EUR 10bn for AI gigafactories.

name: IREN Limited
one_line: Former bitcoin miner selling $9.7bn of GB300 capacity to Microsoft.

name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
one_line: World's largest chip foundry; named as a research user of the Foxconn-Nvidia 10,000-GPU supercomputer, its only disclosed external compute use.

name: Sony Group Corporation
one_line: Japanese electronics and entertainment group; an anchor shareholder of the Noetra national AI factory consortium.

name: NEC Corporation
one_line: Japanese IT company; an anchor shareholder of the Noetra consortium.

name: Honda Motor Co., Ltd.
one_line: Japanese car maker; an anchor shareholder of the Noetra consortium building physical-AI models.

name: SK hynix Inc.
one_line: Korean memory maker committed with Samsung to up to 900,000 DRAM wafer starts a month for OpenAI's Stargate.

name: Soket AI Labs
one_line: Indian start-up selected by the IndiaAI Mission to build a 120bn-parameter model; GPU allocation not published.

name: Gan AI
one_line: Indian start-up selected by the IndiaAI Mission to build a 70bn-parameter text-to-speech model; GPU allocation not published.

name: Bharti Airtel Limited
one_line: Indian telecom operator; connectivity and Nxtra data-centre partner in Google's $15bn Visakhapatnam AI hub.

name: Brookfield Asset Management
one_line: Infrastructure investor; partner in the reported $11bn Reliance Visakhapatnam data-centre campus.

name: Digital Realty Trust, Inc.
one_line: Data-centre REIT; partner in the reported Reliance Visakhapatnam campus and a Singapore DC-CFA2 awardee.
